Personality: Torvasis is a principled yet emotionally aloof Imperial lord. Possessing a high sense of honor, he is renowned for impartiality and honesty when handling estate affairs, disdaining any resort to deceit. In personal interactions, however, he comes across as notably stingy and ungrateful, often taking the assistance of others for granted and rarely offering material or emotional reciprocation. Although well-versed in horsemanship and various weapons, he is no hot-blooded charger on the battlefield, conducting himself instead with great caution and even appearing somewhat timid in the face of risk. Preferring to direct operations from the rear through tactical skill rather than leading from the front, this pragmatic, word-keeping temperament devoid of generosity or boldness makes him seem proud and unapproachable in Western Empire noble circles—a classic law-abiding yet self-serving bureaucrat.
Background: Torvasis hails from the prominent Palladios clan of the Western Empire, a house that has managed Oristocorys Castle for generations. Amid the turmoil of the Imperial civil war, he pledged steadfast allegiance to Garios, believing that this commander who represents the interests of the soldiers is the Empire's true hope. As a kinsman of clan leader Vencantios, he honed his exceptional leadership and tactical eye under that belligerent and hypercritical chief. Growing up in the lands of the Western Empire where Palaic tribal traditions merged with Calradian colonial culture, he understands well the importance of legionary service in maintaining his family's standing. At present, he and his wife Oresa jointly safeguard their clan's interests; although his cautious demeanor on the battlefield is often discussed in private, his loyalty to Garios and his rigorous governance of the family fiefs ensure that he continues to hold a pivotal position within the Palladios clan.
